# NFL Daily — 2026-10-26 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Seahawks' defense and Jaxon Smith-Njigba handed the Chiefs their first loss of the season Sunday night. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50252989/seahawks-beat-chiefs-sunday-night-football-smith-njigba)
- The Vikings are now the NFL's last unbeaten team after Kansas City's loss. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7724411/2026/10/25/vikings-nfl-last-unbeaten-chiefs-49ers/)
- QB-change speculation stayed just speculation: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak reaffirmed Kirk Cousins as starter (Fernando Mendoza "will play at some point," just not this week), while Colts coach Shane Steichen said he hasn't considered benching Daniel Jones. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50289866/kirk-cousins-remain-raiders-starting-qb-klint-kubiak-says) — also [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/colts-bench-daniel-jones-shane-steichen-quarterback/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is "in a decent spot" to play Sunday at Buffalo, coach Jesse Minter said, after missing the last three games. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50290411/ravens-coach-minter-optimistic-qb-jackson-returns-vs-bills)
- 49ers RB Christian McCaffrey said his leg "just died" on him during Sunday's loss to the Falcons. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/49ers-rb-christian-mccaffrey-injury-updates-falcons/)
- Seahawks LT Charles Cross suffered a high-ankle sprain and hopes to return in 1-2 weeks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50288850/source-seahawks-lt-charles-cross-high-ankle-sprain)
- Panthers placed RT Taylor Moton on injured reserve. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2114817003471188152)
- Packers LB Zaire Franklin has a hairline leg fracture; Green Bay has not placed him on injured reserve. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50287123/sources-packers-zaire-franklin-hairline-fracture-leg)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-26 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- Ravens fell to the Bengals 35-13 — their worst loss of the season — extending a pattern of second-half collapses; coach Jesse Minter said the team needs "a little bit more" leadership from its locker room. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2114797830774599968)
- ESPN Analytics now gives Baltimore just a 10.5% chance to win the AFC North and a 49.8% chance to make the playoffs, trailing Cincinnati (68.3%) and Pittsburgh (15.7%). [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2114749594416333170)
- Minter pointed to personnel issues — including TE Durham Smythe's absence — as a factor in Baltimore's struggling run game, while declining to detail changes ahead of Sunday's game at Buffalo. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2114798682092474450)

# Rivals — 2026-10-26 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Chiefs (KC) suffered their first loss of the season, a defensive-driven defeat to the Seahawks on Sunday night. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50252989/seahawks-beat-chiefs-sunday-night-football-smith-njigba)
- Chiefs (KC) coach Andy Reid said kicker Harrison Butker has "gotta fix it" after special-teams issues. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/chiefs-harrison-butker-problem-andy-reid-kicker-gotta-fix-it/)
- Bengals (CIN) routed the Ravens 35-13, with Joe Burrow throwing four touchdowns and no interceptions. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/game-recap-second-half-woes-ravens-bengals-week-7)
- Browns (CLE) QB Deshaun Watson authored his fifth fourth-quarter game-winning drive of the season, beating the Titans 27-24. [Cabot](https://x.com/MaryKayCabot/status/2114724442656141427)
- Steelers (PIT) are shopping for wide receiver help ahead of the trade deadline, an insider tells PennLive. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/10/pittsburgh-steelers-shopping-for-wide-receiver-help-insider-says.html)

## Transactions
- Browns (CLE) DT Maliek Collins officially signed a two-year contract extension. [Cabot](https://x.com/MaryKayCabot/status/2114822565688381778)
